title: Fix jmap-vtc-ring-push-guide.md: answered_elsewhere wrong for multi-party + joinedAt
description: MUST-FIX: (1) 'answered_elsewhere' used for multi-party scenario — wrong. When one target answers a multi-target ring, OTHER TARGETS get endReason 'answered' (different user answered). 'answered_elsewhere' is only for same-user multi-device (different device of same user answered). The spec is explicit about this distinction at line 1502. (2) joinedAt described as if client-set — it is server-set. The spec (line 771) says 'the server sets joinedAt to the current time' as a side effect of the client setting joinMethod.
close_reason: All issues fixed across 11 VTC files
